title: Thank-You Note Overdue Queue
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thankyou:note note_status=* days_overdue=*
| where note_status!="sent" AND days_overdue>7
| sort - days_overdue
| table recipient_name gift_event days_overdue note_status
description: Lists thank-you notes that remain unsent more than seven days after the related gift event.
value: Late thank-you notes feel worse the longer they wait; a visible queue keeps social obligations manageable.
implementation: Track `note_status` and `days_overdue` for each gift and review the queue every Sunday.
visualization: Table of overdue thank-you notes sorted by days overdue.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks thank-you notes you still owe people more than a week after the gift.
